# wordstr

> wordstr is a decentralised magazine and ebook publishing platform built on the Nostr protocol. Publishers upload PDF and EPUB files to Blossom content-addressed storage servers, then broadcast structured Nostr events that describe the publication. Readers can browse, download, and comment on content through any NIP-89-compatible client, or directly on the wordstr web app at https://blog.cloudflareblog.workers.dev.

## Overview

wordstr uses three custom addressable Nostr event kinds (documented in `NIP.md`) plus the standard NIP-23 long-form blog kind:

- **Kind 34609 — Magazine**: A named periodical publication. Carries a title, optional logo image, description, topics, language, and website URL. Identified by `pubkey + kind + d` tag.
- **Kind 39731 — Magazine Issue**: A single issue of a magazine. Carries a free-form issue label (not restricted to numbers), a cover image, a PDF file URL, file size, SHA-256 hash, and a reference to the parent magazine via an `a` tag (`34609:<pubkey>:<d>`).
- **Kind 33953 — Ebook**: A standalone ebook in PDF or EPUB format. Carries a title, cover image, file URL, authors, ISBN, language, topics, and file integrity data.
- **Kind 30023 — Blog Post** (NIP-23): Long-form Markdown articles. Standard fields: `d` slug, `title`, `image`, `summary`, `published_at`, `t` topic tags. Content is raw Markdown rendered with `react-markdown` + `remark-gfm`.
- **Kind 30402 — Classified Listing** (NIP-99): Optional sale listing for an ebook, magazine, magazine issue, or blog post. It carries a `price` tag in satoshis (`["price", "<sats>", "SAT"]`), an `a` tag pointing at the product (`<kind>:<pubkey>:<d>`), a `k` tag naming the product kind, and `status` (`active` or `sold`). Listing `d` values are namespaced for new products (`blog:`, `magazine:`, `issue:`) while ebooks keep the raw slug for backwards compatibility. Buyers pay with a NIP-57 Lightning zap to this listing; no login is required.

All five kinds are **addressable events** (kind range 30000–39999). Editing re-publishes with the same `d` tag, replacing the event in-place on relays. Deletion sends a NIP-09 kind-5 request.

### Paid publication checkout flow

1. The publisher sets a price in satoshis on an ebook, magazine, issue, or blog post. wordstr publishes the product plus a linked NIP-99 kind 30402 listing; clearing the price publishes a `sold` listing that deactivates the sale.
2. A visitor taps "Pay"; the browser generates a temporary Nostr key and signs a NIP-57 kind 9734 zap request targeting the listing (`p` = seller, `a` = listing coordinate, `amount` in millisats).
3. The request is sent to the seller's LNURL-pay callback (from their kind-0 `lud16`/`lud06`) and the returned BOLT11 invoice is shown as a QR code plus a `lightning:` wallet link.
4. wordstr polls relays for a NIP-57 kind 9735 receipt with a matching `a` tag, buyer key (`P` tag or signed `description`), amount, and the wallet's `nostrPubkey`. On match, paid files (EPUB/PDF) download automatically; paid blog posts and magazines unlock in the client.

Files stay on public Blossom mirrors and Nostr event content is public, so a skilled user could discover a file URL or article body without paying. This is an intentional honour-paywall trade-off; no encrypted delivery or backend is involved.

## Technology Stack

- **React 19** with TypeScript, TailwindCSS 4, Vite
- **Nostrify** (`@nostrify/react`, `@nostrify/nostrify`) for Nostr protocol integration
- **TanStack Query** for data fetching and caching
- **React Router v7** for client-side routing
- **shadcn/ui** on Radix UI primitives for accessible UI components
- **react-hook-form** for all publish/edit forms
- **PDF.js** (loaded from CDN as a blob: URL to satisfy CSP) for first-page cover extraction
- **date-fns** for relative timestamps in the comments system
- **@getalby/sdk** (Nostr Wallet Connect, NIP-47) and **qrcode** for NIP-57 Lightning zaps on blog posts
- **@scure/base** for decoding `lud06` LNURL bech32 strings during guest checkout

## Key Source Files

- `src/lib/pressstr.ts` — Kind constants (`KIND_MAGAZINE = 34609`, `KIND_MAGAZINE_ISSUE = 39731`, `KIND_EBOOK = 33953`), TypeScript interfaces for publication data, `extractPdfCover()` (PDF.js wrapper), `slugify()`, `sha256Hex()`, `formatFileSize()`.
- `src/lib/version.ts` — Single source of truth for the app version string (`APP_VERSION`).
- `src/lib/siteOwner.ts` — `SITE_OWNER_PUBKEY`: the hex pubkey whose content appears in the homepage feeds (Magazines, Ebooks, Blogs). All three hooks filter with an `authors` clause at the relay level; direct links to other authors' events still resolve.
- `src/hooks/useOwnerWriteRelays.ts` — Outbox-model relay discovery for the owner feeds: fetches the owner's NIP-65 (kind 10002) write relays (via app relays + purplepag.es / relay.nostr.band) and returns their union with the configured relays and wordstr's built-in archive relays. The built-in fallback remains present after NostrSync replaces the configured list with the signed-in user's relays.
- `src/lib/defaultRelays.ts` — Shared built-in relay URL list used by the app connection pool and as a permanent archive fallback for owner feeds.
- `src/lib/queryRelays.ts` — `queryRelaysMerged()`: queries each relay independently and merges results with `NSet` (dedupe + newest replaceable version, sorted by `published_at`). Owner feeds use this instead of `nostr.group().query()` because a fast relay reaching EOSE early would otherwise abort the whole query and hide posts still arriving from slower relays.
- `src/hooks/useBlossomUpload.ts` — Custom BUD-02 Blossom upload hook. Uploads to all 5 servers in parallel (primal.net, satellite.earth, nostrcheck.me, blossom.band, blossom.ditto.pub), signs a fresh kind-24242 auth event per upload, sniffs MIME type from file extension when `file.type` is empty (mobile Safari compatibility). Returns `BlossomUploadResult` with `url` (primary), `mirrorUrls` (all successes), and `blossomUri` (BUD-10 `blossom:` URI).
- `src/hooks/useMagazines.ts` — TanStack Query hooks: `useMagazines`, `useMagazine`, `useMagazineIssues`, `useMagazineIssue`, `useEbooks`, `useEbook`, `useMyMagazines`.
- `src/hooks/usePublishMagazine.ts` — `publishMagazine`, `publishMagazineIssue`, `publishEbook`, `publishSaleListing` — builds the correct tag arrays and calls `useNostrPublish`. The generic sale listing supports ebooks, magazines, issues, and blog posts.
- `src/hooks/useComments.ts` / `src/hooks/usePostComment.ts` — NIP-22 (kind 1111) comment fetching and posting.
- `src/components/CoverImagePicker.tsx` — Image upload widget with drag-and-drop, preview, and remove button.
- `src/components/PublicationFilePicker.tsx` — PDF/EPUB upload widget with three-phase progress (extracting cover → uploading cover → uploading file) and auto cover extraction.
- `src/components/DownloadButton.tsx` — Forces a real browser download (fetch → Blob → object URL) for cross-origin Blossom files, since the HTML `download` attribute is ignored for cross-origin URLs.
- `src/components/DeleteEventButton.tsx` — NIP-09 deletion with AlertDialog confirmation.
- `src/components/MagazineView.tsx` — Magazine detail page (logo, description, paid-unlock or issue grid, owner edit/delete menu).
- `src/components/IssueView.tsx` — Issue detail page (cover, metadata, paid checkout or direct download, NIP-22 comments section).
- `src/components/EbookView.tsx` — Ebook detail page (cover, metadata, free download or paid checkout, NIP-22 comments section).
- `src/lib/nip99.ts` — NIP-99 kind constants and helpers: event coordinates, namespaced listing `d` values, `price` tag parsing (satoshis), and listing→product linking.
- `src/lib/lightning.ts` — Guest checkout protocol helpers: LNURL-pay endpoint resolution from kind-0 metadata and NIP-57 zap receipt validation (buyer, listing, amount, wallet pubkey).
- `src/lib/download.ts` — Shared cross-origin Blob download helper used by free and paid file downloads.
- `src/hooks/useSaleListing.ts` — Finds the NIP-99 listing attached to any addressable product by `a` coordinate (with a `d`-tag fallback for legacy ebook listings).
- `src/hooks/useNip99Purchase.ts` — Guest checkout state machine: temporary key, zap-request signing, invoice creation, receipt polling, and session restore.
- `src/components/PurchaseCard.tsx` — Shared paid-content UI: price, QR invoice, `lightning:` wallet link, copy invoice, payment status, and automatic file download on receipt.
- `src/components/comments/CommentsSection.tsx` — NIP-22 threaded comment renderer.
- `src/hooks/useBlogs.ts` — TanStack Query hooks: `useBlogs` (global feed), `useAuthorBlogs` (by pubkey), `useBlogPost` (single by pubkey+d). Exports `KIND_BLOG_POST = 30023`.
- `src/hooks/useNostrExtension.ts` — Detects a NIP-07 signer (`window.nostr.getPublicKey` + `signEvent`), re-checking after mount and on window focus so late-injecting extensions are found. Powers the first-class “Sign in with browser extension” button in `AuthDialog`.
- `src/components/BlogPostView.tsx` — Blog post detail: paid-content unlock, theme-aware Markdown renderer, promo video, "Zap the author" card, "Listen in Boris" deep link (read.withboris.com/a/<naddr> with relay hints, for Boris's TTS reader), author card, NIP-22 comments.
- `src/components/PromoVideo.tsx` — Resolves Divine video links (kind 34236) and plays them inline.
- `src/components/ZapDialog.tsx` / `ZapButton.tsx` / `WalletModal.tsx` — NIP-57 zap UI: amount presets, comment, invoice QR fallback, and NWC wallet management.
- `src/contexts/NWCContext.tsx` + `src/hooks/useNWC.ts` / `useWallet.ts` / `useZaps.ts` — Nostr Wallet Connect (NIP-47) connection state (localStorage), WebLN detection, and the NIP-57 zap-request → LNURL invoice → payment pipeline.
- `src/components/AppProvider.tsx` + `index.html` — Force dark mode on every route, including visitors with legacy light/system preferences. Dark tokens are defined in `src/index.css`; no theme switcher is shown.
- `src/pages/BlogListPage.tsx` — Author profile page showing profile banner, avatar, bio, and all blog posts.
- `src/pages/publish/PublishBlogPage.tsx` — Markdown editor with Write/Preview tabs and optional price for new blog posts.
- `src/pages/edit/EditBlogPage.tsx` — Pre-filled edit form for existing blog posts with auto-saved local drafts and sale-price sync.
- `src/pages/DraftsPage.tsx` — Lists saved local blog post drafts with continue / delete actions.
- `src/components/BlogPostEditor.tsx` — Shared Markdown editor, preview, hero image, and draft auto-save component.
- `src/hooks/useBlogDrafts.ts` — localStorage draft CRUD scoped to the logged-in pubkey.
- `src/pages/Index.tsx` — Home page with Magazines / Ebooks / Blogs tabs.
- `src/pages/ChangelogPage.tsx` — Full release history at `/changelog`.
- `src/pages/NIP19Page.tsx` — NIP-19 router: decodes naddr identifiers and renders the correct view.
- `src/pages/publish/` — Publish forms: `PublishPage`, `PublishMagazinePage`, `PublishIssuePage`, `PublishEbookPage`, `PublishBlogPage`.
- `src/pages/edit/` — Edit forms: `EditMagazinePage`, `EditIssuePage`, `EditEbookPage`, `EditBlogPage`.
- `src/AppRouter.tsx` — All routes.
- `src/components/NostrProvider.tsx` — Shared Nostr relay pool. Waits up to 5 seconds after the first EOSE so slower outbox relays can return addressable content before feeds are finalized. Owner completeness is handled separately by `queryRelaysMerged()`.
- `NIP.md` — Full specification of the three custom Nostr event kinds.
- `public/llms.txt` — This file.

## Routes

| Path | Description |
|---|---|
| `/` | Home — browse all magazines and ebooks |
| `/changelog` | Full release history |
| `/publish` | Publish hub |
| `/publish/magazine` | Create a new magazine |
| `/publish/issue` | Publish a new issue to an existing magazine |
| `/publish/ebook` | Publish a standalone ebook |
| `/edit/magazine/:naddr` | Edit a magazine (owner only) |
| `/edit/issue/:naddr` | Edit a magazine issue (owner only) |
| `/edit/ebook/:naddr` | Edit an ebook (owner only) |
| `/publish/blog` | Write a new NIP-23 blog post |
| `/publish/blog?draft=<id>` | Continue writing a saved draft |
| `/edit/blog/:naddr` | Edit a blog post (owner only) |
| `/drafts` | Saved blog post drafts (localStorage, owner only) |
| `/:nip19` | NIP-19 universal route: npub → author blog list; naddr → magazine/issue/ebook/blog |

## Nostr Event Kinds

| Kind | Name | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30023 | Blog Post | Addressable | NIP-23 long-form Markdown article |
| 34609 | Magazine | Addressable | Named publication, groups issues |
| 39731 | Magazine Issue | Addressable | Single PDF issue of a magazine |
| 33953 | Ebook | Addressable | Standalone PDF or EPUB ebook |
| 30402 | Classified Listing | Addressable | NIP-99 sale listing for any paid publication |
| 1111 | Comment | Regular | NIP-22 threaded comment |
| 5 | Deletion | Regular | NIP-09 deletion request |
| 24242 | Blossom Auth | Regular | BUD-02 upload authorisation event |

## Blossom File Hosting

All files (PDFs, EPUBs, cover images, logos) are uploaded to Blossom servers using the BUD-02 `PUT /upload` endpoint. The upload hook (`useBlossomUpload`) signs a kind-24242 auth event with:

- `t: upload`
- `x: <sha256-hex>`
- `size: <bytes>`
- `expiration: <unix-timestamp + 300s>`

All 5 servers are tried **in parallel** — every successful upload becomes a mirror. Published events carry one `url` tag per successful mirror for fallback redundancy. If all servers fail, the error is surfaced directly to the user.

### BUD-10 `blossom:` URI

After a successful upload to one or more servers, a [BUD-10](https://github.com/hzrd149/blossom/blob/master/buds/10.md) `blossom:` URI is constructed:

```
blossom:<sha256>.<ext>?xs=<domain>[&xs=<domain>...]&as=<pubkey>&sz=<bytes>
```

This URI is stored in a `blossom` tag on issue and ebook events. It encodes the content hash, all mirror server hints (`xs=`), the uploader's pubkey (`as=`), and the file size (`sz=`). Clients that understand BUD-10 can use it to resolve the blob from any available mirror, even if the primary URL is offline.

## PDF Cover Extraction

When publishing an issue or ebook from a PDF and no cover image is provided, wordstr automatically renders the first page of the PDF to a JPEG at ~600 px wide and uploads it to Blossom. This uses PDF.js loaded from `cdnjs.cloudflare.com` via a dynamically-injected `<script type="module">` pointing at a `blob:` URL (required to satisfy the CSP while avoiding bundler interception). The worker URL is set to the same CDN.

## Authentication & Login

Users log in with a Nostr identity. Supported signer types:
- NIP-07 browser extension (e.g. Alby, nos2x)
- nsec (secret key, stored in localStorage — plaintext; use with care)
- NIP-46 remote signer (bunker://)

The `LoginArea` component handles all login flows via `@nostrify/react/login`. NIP-07 is a first-class option on the first screen of `AuthDialog` when a signer is detected; nsec and NIP-46 remain available under “I already have an account”.

## Security Notes

- All user-supplied URLs are not currently run through a sanitizer; future work should add `sanitizeUrl()` before using them as `href` or `src`.
- CSP in `index.html` allows `script-src 'self' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com blob:` specifically for the PDF.js CDN loader pattern.
- Nostr private keys stored via nsec login are in plaintext localStorage. XSS is the primary threat; `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` is never used.

## Visual Design

- **Colour scheme**: Black × Purple × White
  - Light mode: white background, near-black text, violet-600 primary
  - Dark mode: near-black background (#0d0a14), white text, violet-500 primary
- **Hero section**: Dark gradient (black → purple-950 → violet-900) with dot-grid overlay and glow blobs
- **Brand**: gradient "wordstr" wordmark (violet → purple)
